item.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
item.description: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

item.title: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
item.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

item.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says

item.title: The business of El Niño
item.description: El Niño is expected to bring wild weather, but it's also business opportunity for some. Contractors are booked up as homeowners prepare for heavy rains and ski resorts gear up to cash in on snow.

item.title: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
